description: This Java class 'LoggingConfigurationGlobalPropertyListener' implements the 'GlobalPropertyListener' interface to monitor and respond to changes in logging-related global properties within the OpenMRS system. It updates logging configurations dynamically when relevant properties are modified or deleted.

classes.name: LoggingConfigurationGlobalPropertyListener
classes.description: A listener class that observes changes to global properties related to logging and updates the system's logging configuration accordingly.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Determines if the given property name is one of the logging-related global properties supported by this listener.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles the event where a global property related to logging has been changed, triggering reconfiguration as needed.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles the removal of a global property, resetting internal state and reloading logging configuration.
